### How to submit
1. Keep the seminar metadata below.
2. If the paper already has a PDF link, leave Paper Attachment unchanged.
3. To submit a PPT/PDF file, click under Slides Attachment and drag the file into this GitHub issue editor. GitHub will insert an upload link there.
4. Click Submit new issue.
